claims.text: The source defines LoRA: freeze W0, learn low-rank update deltaW=BA (r much smaller than dimensions) applied to query/value projections, Gaussian-A + zero-B initialisation, alpha/r scaling; merged W=W0+BA at inference gives zero extra latency, task switching by swapping A/B.

Reported numbers: GPT-3 175B adaptation 10,000x fewer parameters (35 MB vs 350 GB), VRAM 1.2 TB to 350 GB, 25% speedup; RoBERTa-large average 89.0 vs 88.9 full finetune; GPT-2-medium E2E BLEU 70.4 vs 68.2.

limitations.text: Cross-task batching hard if merged; MLP/LN/bias excluded; rank tuning needed.
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.

limitations.text: Diffusion-LoRA media-specific behaviour not evidenced (LLM/NLU/NLG only).
